Shop to bank on rent 2431 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 57768 Country: India Title: About Cosmetic products Question: I need to some more things to know is that the use of cosmetic products such as face and body creams which contains a very small amount of CETYL ALCOHOL is allowed or not. Is CETYL ALCOHOL haram for us or not? It is not used for drinking purpose. It is just a family member of alcohol family . ETHYL ALCOHOL is used for drinking purpose. I just want to. Answer ID: 57768 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 761/761/N=09/1436) Alcohols which are prevalent nowadays are not prepared by grapes or dates rather they are prepared by various grains, vegetables, patrol and coal etc. And such alcohols as per Imam Abu Hanifah and Imam Abu Yusuf, may Allah have mercy upon them, neither are haram nor impure. So it is mentioned in the books of Fiqh and Fatawa. In this age, for the purpose of treatment and general use the Ulama have preferred the views of Imam Abu Hanifah and Imam Abu Yusuf, may Allah have mercy upon them. Principally, the opinion of the Shaikhain (Imam Abu Hanifah and Imam Abu Yusuf) are usually preferred. And in this case the basis on which the view of Imam Muhammad, may Allah have mercy upon him, was preferred it is generally inexistent in alcohol mixed things. Also as you said that alcohol is used in less quantity in cosmetic products, hence you may use it as per the Shariah, it is allowable. However, if someone avoids it then it is better and is his piety. (در مختار و ردالمحتار 10:27-36، مطبوعه: مكتبه زكريا ديوبند، تكمله فتح الملهم 1:515، 516، 3:506، 507 مطبوعه: دار إحياء التراث العربي بيروت، فتاوى محموديه جديد ڈابھیل 18: 191، 192، منتخبات نظام الفتاوى 3: 385، كتاب الفتاوى 6: 205، احسن الفتاوى 2: 95، محمود الفتاوى 1: 362-364، 4: 379، 740، اسلام اور جديد معاشى مسائل 4: 11-13 بحواله فقهى مقالات، تكملة فتح الملهم اور انعام البارى). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
